root_cause.text: The function `get_devt_from_fd()` in the RDMA core only verified the device number (`dev_t`) of a passed file descriptor without checking that the file's operations match the expected ucap character device file operations, allowing a block device with the same `dev_t` to be falsely accepted as a ucap cdev.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "it is not safe to rely only on the devt because char/block alias so if the user finds a block device with the same dev_t it can masquerade as a ucap cdev fd." The patch adds a check `fd_file(f)->f_op != &ucaps_cdev_fops` to ensure only authentic cdevs are accepted.
